The transformation rule is:

- Keep every non-zero cell unchanged.
- For each `0` cell at position `(row, col)`, replace it with the value from the transposed position `(col, row)`.
- This makes the entire output grid symmetric across the main diagonal.

So if `input[r][c] == 0`, then `output[r][c] = input[c][r]`; otherwise `output[r][c] = input[r][c]`.

Please provide the held-out input grid so I can apply this rule and submit the resulting output.
